tests.name: idempotent_import_replay_same_key_is_noop
tests.assertion: Same package imported twice: first=Committed(rev=1), second=Replayed; revision does not advance; no duplicate rows

tests.name: idempotent_import_tamper_rejected_before_write
tests.assertion: Tampered manifest.package_checksum → PackageChecksumMismatch at validation; bus never invoked; revision unchanged

tests.name: idempotent_import_unknown_required_skipped_not_aborted
tests.assertion: Record with no id/kind: skipped_count=1, valid_count=2, import_count=2; import commits for valid records

tests.name: idempotent_import_unknown_optional_preserved
tests.assertion: Records with custom_tag and score extra fields: all 3 records valid; fields intact after validation; import commits

tests.name: idempotent_import_quota_record_count_rejected_before_write
tests.assertion: max_records=2 but 3 records → RecordCountExceedsLimit(3, max=2); revision unchanged

tests.name: idempotent_import_quota_bytes_rejected_before_write
tests.assertion: max_total_bytes = actual_bytes - 1 → TotalBytesExceedsLimit; zero authority writes

tests.name: idempotent_import_cancellation_leaves_no_partial_writes
tests.assertion: Validation passes but bus.submit_deferred is not called (cancellation); revision unchanged; event_count=0

tests.name: idempotent_import_crash_retry_is_idempotent
tests.assertion: Original=Committed(rev=1); retry with same key=Replayed; revision does not advance; no duplicate rows

nonNegotiablesVerified: Tampered packages MUST be rejected before any write: idempotent_import_tamper_rejected_before_write
Replay MUST be idempotent (second import produces same result, no duplicate rows): idempotent_import_replay_same_key_is_noop
Cancellation MUST leave no partial writes: idempotent_import_cancellation_leaves_no_partial_writes
Unknown required skipped, import not aborted: idempotent_import_unknown_required_skipped_not_aborted

importPipeline.idempotencyMechanism: ImportIdempotencyKey = SHA-256(package_checksum:policy_namespace); mapped to IdempotencyKey on CommandEnvelope; bus returns Replayed on duplicate key
importPipeline.atomicityGuarantee: AuthorityTransaction is one SQLite transaction; pre-submit cancellation or validation failure leaves zero authority rows
importPipeline.tamperGuarantee: PackageChecksumVerifier::verify runs before bus invocation; mismatch → error before BEGIN
importPipeline.quotaGuarantee: Record count and byte limits checked before PackageChecksumVerifier and before bus invocation
